subject.title: fix(gateway): preserve restart intent across coalesced config writes

question: Should an earlier pending restart request remain mandatory when a later coalesced configuration write supplies the newest config and explicitly has no restart intent?
rationale: The patch makes this restart-precedence rule explicit; focused mocked coverage shows the intended state transition, but maintainers must confirm the lifecycle policy and its availability tradeoff.

options.title: Adopt sticky pending restart intent
options.body: Confirm that every committed pending restart remains required until processing, then merge after real gateway proof of the three-write sequence.

options.title: Recompute intent from final state
options.body: Require the reloader to derive restart necessity from the newest candidate instead, avoiding a restart when a later write fully supersedes the earlier change.

recommendation.title: Adopt sticky pending restart intent
recommendation.body: Confirm that every committed pending restart remains required until processing, then merge after real gateway proof of the three-write sequence.

likelyOwner.reason: No current-main gateway reloader ownership trail could be established without the required readable local history.
